name: SM Easy Post Migrator
author: steviemathew

sections.description:
SM Easy Post Migrator is a powerful and user-friendly plugin for migrating posts, pages, media, and internal links from one WordPress site to another. It supports both manual and REST API-based migrations, ensuring that your content, images, and links remain intact.

Features:
* Secure REST API connection with application passwords
* Select specific posts, pages, or media to migrate
* Automatic internal link remapping
* Media migration with deduplication
* Real-time progress and detailed logs
* Batch processing for large sites
* Export migration results to CSV
* Modern, responsive admin interface

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPL v2 or later.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, visit https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/sm-easy-post-migrator/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/content-migration-pro directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Content Migrator’ in the admin menu.
  4. Follow the on-screen instructions to connect to your source site and start migrating content.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin migrate users or comments?

No, SM Easy Post Migrator focuses on posts, pages, media, and internal links. User and comment migration is not supported in this version.

What are the requirements?

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • REST API enabled on the source site
  • Application password for secure connection

Can I migrate custom post types?

Currently, the plugin supports standard posts, pages, and media. Support for custom post types is planned for a future release.

How are internal links handled?

The plugin automatically detects and remaps internal links to match the new site structure, including media URLs.

What if I hit the free post limit?

The free version allows up to 20 posts per migration.
